complexity.notes: The `if size < 1` guard is dead code given the constraint n >= 1 implies a non-empty list, but harmless. A one-pass two-pointer (fast/slow) variant would be more idiomatic, though asymptotically identical.
complexity.summary: Two-pass approach: first count the list length, then walk to the (size - n)th node using a dummy pre-head and unlink the target node. The dummy node cleanly handles removing the original head.
